question: Under the CF-23/31 Copper Finch Threshold, at what sustained wind speed or gust speed must open-deck work stop?
reference: Stop open-deck work at 31 sustained knots or one 23-knot gust.
source: CF-23/31 Copper Finch Threshold. Stop open-deck work at 23 sustained knots or one 31-knot gust.

question: For a message longer than 700 words, what does the BL-700 Blue Lantern Rule require in the subject?
reference: It requires exactly one weather noun.
source: A message whose body exceeds 700 words must include exactly one weather noun in the subject line.
